definitions.explanation: The service of delivering goods to someone's home or a specified address.

examples.japanese: {宅配|たくはい}⟦{便|びん}→便：01877_bin⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：02027_nimotsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{送|おく}る→送る：00742_okuru⟧。
examples.english: To send a package by home delivery service.

examples.japanese: {宅配|たくはい}⟦ピザ→ピザ：06406_piza⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{頼|たの}んだ→頼む：00699_tanomu⟧。
{宅配|たくはい}⟦ボックス→ボックス：06817_bokkusu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{届|とど}いていた→届く：00712_todoku⟧。
examples.english: It had been delivered to the delivery box.

notes:
{宅配|たくはい} means home delivery service. It's commonly seen in compounds.

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {宅配便|たくはいびん} (delivery service, courier service)
- {宅配|たくはい}ピザ (pizza delivery)
- {宅配|たくはい}ボックス (delivery box/locker)

RELATED TERMS:
- {配達|はいたつ} (delivery - more general term)
- {出前|でまえ} (food delivery from restaurants)
